nodes.title: Place redox flask
nodes.description: Place the Erlenmeyer flask on the workbench.

feedback.retry: Review Place redox flask and try again.

nodes.title: Measure analyte
nodes.description: Pour 10 mL of redox analyte into the graduated cylinder.

feedback.retry: Review Measure analyte and try again.

nodes.title: Transfer analyte
nodes.description: Pour the analyte into the Erlenmeyer flask.

feedback.retry: Review Transfer analyte and try again.

nodes.title: Acidify analyte
nodes.description: Pour acid reagent into the analyte before titration.

feedback.retry: Review Acidify analyte and try again.

nodes.title: Mount the burette
nodes.description: Seat the burette in the ring-stand clamp so the stopcock is reachable and the tip clears the receiving vessel. Nothing may be delivered from a hand-held burette.

validation.label: Burette mounted on the ring stand.

feedback.retry: Clamp the burette to the ring stand before filling it.

nodes.title: Fill burette
nodes.description: Pour permanganate titrant into the burette.

feedback.retry: Review Fill burette and try again.

nodes.title: Read the initial burette level
nodes.description: Read the meniscus on the filled burette. Reading and recording are separate steps.

feedback.retry: Read the burette before recording its value.

nodes.title: Record initial burette
nodes.description: Record the initial redox burette reading.

feedback.retry: Review Record initial burette and try again.

nodes.title: Deliver titrant
nodes.description: Pour permanganate titrant into the flask to a faint endpoint.

feedback.retry: Review Deliver titrant and try again.

nodes.title: Record final burette
nodes.description: Record the final redox burette reading.

feedback.retry: Review Record final burette and try again.

nodes.title: Calculate peroxide
nodes.description: Calculate hydrogen peroxide percent from titration evidence.

feedback.retry: Review Calculate peroxide and try again.
